display.title: Episode 25: Saved by Negel Vasser (Erev Shavuos)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's pre-Shavuos show: Hashem's gift of water, how washing negel vasser in prison saved Rabbi Akiva, Ahavas Yisroel, and why everyone should hear the Ten Commandments.
display.summary_long: Broadcast two days before Shavuos 5742. Uncle Yossi opens by inviting children to recite the Shema in Studio 604 and previews a story about Rabbi Akiva. Before the Shema he explains why doing mitzvos together, achdus, matters so much, and a boy from Staten Island leads the Shema. He then teaches about water: Hashem placed the sun at just the right distance so the oceans neither boil nor freeze, and gave water the power of purity, which is why the Kohen washed at the Mishkan's basin and we wash negel vasser each morning. The story follows: Rabbi Akiva, jailed for teaching Torah, receives a jug of water after three days without food or drink, and uses it to wash his hands and make a brachah. The amazed ruler frees him and makes him his advisor. Uncle Yossi then explains Rabbi Akiva's teaching that loving every Jew is a great rule of the Torah and leads to loving Hashem, and urges everyone, young and old, to come to shul on Shavuos to hear the Ten Commandments together. A sponsor message and a word on Naaseh V'nishma close the show.
display.lesson: Treasure every mitzvah, as Rabbi Akiva did, and love every Jew; standing together as one, we receive the Torah anew each Shavuos.

date.note: 'Thursday is Erev Shavuos; Shavuos is Friday and Shabbos' fits Tuesday 3 Sivan 5742. Matches the weekly estimate.

advisories.note: Rabbi Akiva is jailed for teaching Torah and left three days without food or water.
Torah study was forbidden and severely punished in Rabbi Akiva's time.

privacy.note: Shema guest named in full, with age and town.

sources_cited.note: 'Our Sages tell us' that the pure voices of children learning Torah reach the Heavenly Throne.
'Love your fellow as yourself', which Rabbi Akiva calls a great rule of the Torah.
